definition: Customer need and pest context are clear enough for manual classification.
success_signal: specific pest or service need stated
recommended_manual_check: Verify stated pest and requested scope in redacted transcript.

definition: Appointment timing, confirmation, and service window are clear.
success_signal: appointment scheduled and confirmed
stuck_signal: time unclear or repeated scheduling friction
pipeline_signal: future appointment discussed but not closed
recommended_manual_check: Check appointment status without inferring completion.

definition: Manual handling of schedule changes or reentry constraints.
success_signal: reschedule recovered to service or paid outcome
recommended_manual_check: Separate recovered jobs from unresolved reschedules.

definition: Reentry or household constraint is handled in the flow.
success_signal: constraint handled before or after service
deferred_signal: customer delays due to household needs
recommended_manual_check: Redact household identifiers and private timing details.

definition: Post-treatment concern is explained without claiming new outcome.
success_signal: concern addressed with registry-supported context
deferred_signal: customer waits before deciding next step
recommended_manual_check: Do not convert concern into failure or success without registry support.

definition: Delayed pest activity or delayed contact is captured as an expectation gap.
success_signal: gap identified and attached to completed case
recommended_manual_check: Keep explanation internal and do not generalize treatment advice.

definition: Preparation steps are recorded as internal evidence quality.
success_signal: prep instructions were given
recommended_manual_check: Do not create new customer instructions.

definition: Access logistics are clear enough for manual review.
success_signal: access resolved
recommended_manual_check: Redact addresses, apartment numbers, and access details.

definition: Remote access is granted or managed under trust context.
success_signal: remote access handled and service completed
stuck_signal: access details create risk or uncertainty
recommended_manual_check: Strictly redact codes, keys, alarms, video instructions, and locations.

definition: A third party coordinates booking for another recipient.
success_signal: proxy booking leads to completed service
recommended_manual_check: Redact family relationship when identifying.

definition: Recipient acceptance is separated from proxy intent.
success_signal: recipient accepts and service proceeds
recommended_manual_check: Do not treat proxy demand as recipient buy-in.

definition: Existing customer returns or reactivates service need.
success_signal: returning customer completes service
pipeline_signal: repeat account may create future pipeline
recommended_manual_check: Verify repeat status from registry only.

definition: Move timing affects scheduling or access.
success_signal: pre-move timing resolved to completed service
recommended_manual_check: Redact addresses and move timing details.

definition: Conversation reveals added service scope.
success_signal: expanded scope completed and paid when confirmed
stuck_signal: scope unclear or hard to price
recommended_manual_check: Do not count added scope unless closed, performed, and paid.

definition: Private unit plus building common area combined scope is detected.
success_signal: combo job completed and paid
recommended_manual_check: Separate private job outcome from building pipeline.

definition: Building common area need is identified as potential pipeline.
success_signal: completed only if registry confirms closure and payment
recommended_manual_check: Keep building opportunity separate from outcome.

definition: Multiple sites or account contexts are detected.
success_signal: multi-site services completed and paid
recommended_manual_check: Redact institution or site identifiers.

definition: Family-related additional units are detected as pipeline.
success_signal: primary job outcome remains separate
recommended_manual_check: Do not count family units as outcome until closed, performed, and paid.

definition: Committee referral or building contact is identified as pipeline.
success_signal: private job outcome remains separate
recommended_manual_check: Redact committee contacts and building identifiers.

definition: Photo or visual evidence supports triage or next step.
success_signal: visual evidence leads to supported completed outcome
pipeline_signal: visual evidence may support future step
recommended_manual_check: Do not inspect private images; use registry notes only.

definition: Operator field evidence is captured and explained remotely.
success_signal: operator-confirmed explanation supports completed case
recommended_manual_check: Redact property visuals and private field details.

definition: Environmental pest source is identified in registry evidence.
success_signal: source identified and service completed
recommended_manual_check: Do not create treatment recommendations.

definition: Rodent uncertainty is triaged and resolved or deferred.
success_signal: confirmed capture or closed service
recommended_manual_check: Do not infer closure from inquiry alone.

definition: Customer chooses DIY or non-service path.
success_signal: not applicable unless later separately closed
recommended_manual_check: Do not count DIY deferral as revenue.

definition: Limited availability or alternative slot handling is captured.
success_signal: capacity issue recovered to completed service
recommended_manual_check: Verify service completion separately from appointment offer.

definition: Original or alternative appointment stability is tracked.
success_signal: appointment preserved or stable through change
recommended_manual_check: Do not count appointment stability as payment.

definition: Repeat customer price anchor is handled by scope explanation.
success_signal: repriced scope completed and paid
recommended_manual_check: Do not create pricing automation or recommendations.

definition: Multiple pest issues are clarified into internal scope.
success_signal: scope clarified and completed when confirmed
recommended_manual_check: Do not generalize treatment recommendations.

definition: Partial payment or reconciliation is tracked only when explicit.
success_signal: payment reconciliation completed and payment received
recommended_manual_check: Do not infer payment from invoice visibility.

definition: Invoice or receipt evidence is tracked separately from payment.
success_signal: invoice or receipt issued with explicit payment if present
deferred_signal: invoice visible but payment not confirmed
recommended_manual_check: Keep invoice visibility separate from payment_received.

definition: Review request is tracked as pipeline only.
success_signal: request sent after service, not review received
recommended_manual_check: Never count review_request_sent as review_received.

definition: Referral sharing is detected as pipeline only unless separately converted.
success_signal: service outcome remains separate from referral signal
recommended_manual_check: Never count referral_shared as converted referral.

definition: Manual reviewer separates closed outcomes from pipeline and unresolved signals.
success_signal: closed, performed, paid or operationally confirmed outcome
stuck_signal: stuck signal is not converted into outcome
deferred_signal: negative or deferred case remains separate
recommended_manual_check: Check source registry outcome and opportunity rows before scoring.
